# Victor Hultgren — District Loss Prevention Manager

- **Relationship:** cross-org partner from **Loss Prevention** — no reporting line to Marc, but they work
  the shrink problem together. Covers LP for the whole district.
- **Cadence:** monthly shrink review; on-site quarterly audit. In-store LP walk last done **2026-07-08**.
- **Owns:** the [Shrink Reduction Plan](../projects/shrink-reduction-plan.md) from the LP side — exception
  reporting (refunds, voids, no-sales), CCTV, and audit scoring. Marc's AM
  [Jordan Alvarez](../people/jordan-alvarez.md) is his day-to-day counterpart in the store.
- **How to work with him:** data-driven and blunt; he'll show Marc the exception report and expect a named
  corrective action per flag. Respects managers who own their numbers rather than blaming associates.
- **Sensitivities:** careful about anything touching a specific associate — LP matters can become HR matters
  fast; loop in [Angela Foster](../people/angela-foster.md) before acting on a person.
